findings.sourceQuestion: I fedeli sono obbligati a manifestare all’autorità ecclesiastica gl’impedimenti matrimoniali che conoscono?
findings.issue: Opening draft asks only why banns were published and omits the direct affirmative obligation to disclose known impediments to ecclesiastical authority; original Q848 expressly states that obligation, with banns as consequence.

en.question: Does the 1905 Catechism require the faithful to disclose known marriage impediments?
en.answer: Yes. The 1905 Catechism says the faithful are obliged to report marriage impediments known to them to ecclesiastical authority; it gives the publication of marriage banns as a means of bringing such impediments to light. This describes the historical catechism, not an assessment of any individual marriage under current law.

fr.question: Le Catéchisme de 1905 demande-t-il aux fidèles de signaler les empêchements de mariage qu'ils connaissent ?
fr.answer: Oui. Le Catéchisme de 1905 enseigne que les fidèles doivent signaler à l'autorité ecclésiastique les empêchements de mariage dont ils ont connaissance ; il rattache à cette obligation la publication des bans. Il s'agit de l'enseignement historique du catéchisme, non d'une appréciation d'un mariage particulier selon le droit actuel.
